text: DSH Intelligent Router 是面向 DSH web 的模型路由插件，在 DSH 中注册 auto 模型提供方，并通过路由组把请求交给已配置的模型。它支持按优先级、任务规模、轮换和使用量排序，结合规则匹配与会话缓存亲和，并在模型调用失败时切换候选项。设置界面可管理模型、策略和配额，适合需要在多个模型间分配 DSH 请求的用户；需要先在 DSH 配置模型提供方。

DSH Intelligent Router adds an auto model provider to DSH web. It routes requests through configured model groups using priority, task size, rotation, usage, and rules; eligible failures fall through to another candidate. A settings UI manages models, strategies, and quotas.

I need rules that send image or long-token requests to a chosen model.
DSH Intelligent Router 的功能「路由组策略」：为模型成员配置顺序、轮换、使用量或任务规模策略；发起请求时按策略排列候选模型。
DSH Intelligent Router 的功能「规则路由」：可按请求条件匹配规则，将命中的目标模型放到候选链首位，再继续尝试其他成员。
DSH Intelligent Router 的功能「自动故障切换」：模型调用失败且错误符合回退条件时，路由器会继续尝试候选模型，并记录回退事件。
DSH Intelligent Router 的功能「缓存亲和」：可设置关闭、单轮、自动或会话模式，让最近成功的模型在缓存有效时保持优先。
DSH Intelligent Router 的功能「路由配置界面」：在设置页管理路由组、模型成员、策略、规则和配额，并通过更新回调保存设置。

dsh-llm-router README · DSH Intelligent Router：The router registers itself as the **`auto`** provider in DSH. Pick **AUTO – Intelligent Router** as your model and every request is routed to the best member of your configured route group — with rules, strategies, failover, and prompt-cache-aware staying working under the hood.

dsh-llm-router README · Routing：- **Route groups** — organize members (provider + model) and manage them from the Settings UI
- **Four routing strategies** — `order` (priority) · `smart` (task-size aware: local vs cloud) · `rotate` (round-robin) · `usage` (least-used first)
- **Rule engine** — `minTokens` / `hasImage` / `anyAgent` / `intent` conditions; the first matching rule pins its target model to the front of the candidate chain
- **Intent routing** — a lightweight classifier model (your choice) labels the message intent; rules route on it
- **Stays (cache affinity)** — `off` / `turn` / `auto` / `session` (default `session`): keeps the last successful member at the front while the vendor prompt cache is worth keeping, keyed per DSH session

dsh-llm-router README · Reliability：- **Automatic failover** — three-tier error classification (TRANSIENT / PERMANENT / UNKNOWN), no false positives: auth and validation errors never burn retries; connection, rate-limit, and 5xx errors fall through to the next candidate
- **Quota guard** — members that exceed limits are skipped without consuming a retry

dsh-llm-router README · Experience：- **Settings UI** (Magpie-style, zh/en) — model picker fed from DSH's configured models, strategy pills, rule builder, intent-classifier selection, save-time validation, live persistence via the DSH settings service
- **Observability** — per-group/per-member metrics, latency tracking, cost estimates, and `router/fallback` events (host side)

dsh-llm-router README · Requirements：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` (declared in [`compatibility.json`](compatibility.json))
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en) `>= 18` (DSH runtime), pnpm for development

dsh-llm-router README · Or build from source：> [!WARNING]
> **First-time install requires a DSH restart.** The plugin's loader entry and client bundle are composed into the boot graph **at server startup**. 
> If DSH is already running when you install, it will not notice the new package — the Settings UI (and the `auto` provider) will be missing until you restart.
> Stop the running `dsh web` process and start it again; a browser reload alone is not enough. Subsequent changes to routing config (Save in the Settings UI) or rebuilt plugin bundles are picked up live via HMR — only package-level install/remove needs a restart.
> **Waiting for DSH support in the future.**

dsh-llm-router README · Or build from source：> Start DSH from the profile directory with the **local binary** (`cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && ./node_modules/.bin/dsh web --port 3082`). Launching via `npx` can load a duplicate module tree and break settings writes.

dsh-llm-router README · Quick Start：1. Start DSH and open **Settings → Built-in plugins → LLM Router**
2. Click **+ Add model** to pick members from your DSH-configured providers
3. Choose a strategy (default: `order`); optionally add rules
4. Click **Save** (persists immediately via the DSH settings service)
5. In chat, select **AUTO – Intelligent Router** — done

Use a specific group with provider `group/<groupId>`.

dsh-llm-router README · Configuration Reference：Persisted by the Settings UI into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`id: llm-router`). A minimal example:

```yaml
- id: llm-router
  name: 'dsh-llm-router'
  config:
    enabled: true

dsh-llm-router README · Roadmap：- `pace` / `weighted` / `intent` strategies are declared in the schema but **not implemented** (they silently degrade to `order`) — implement or prune
- Stays windows (`turn` ≈ 2 min, `auto` ≈ 5 min) are hardcoded approximations — make configurable
- Quota limits are hardcoded (1M tokens/day, 1k requests/day) and never auto-reset — wire up `quotaTracking.limits`
- Monitoring data has no UI channel yet (panel shows mock data)
- Middleware system is implemented but not wired into the request path
- Prune the legacy dual call path (`route()` waterfall / `llm-client.ts`)
